variants.label: H1: farmer and Puja
variants.who: KarmYog for the 21st Century and Bharatiya Krishak Samaj, jointly.
variants.what: A Durga Puja that celebrates farming, with a working integrated farm on the Puja ground.
variants.when: Durga Puja 2026. Civic holidays are documented. Ritual clocks await a named Panjika.
variants.where: Munshir Bheri Management / Fishermen's Committee, Near Sukantanagar, Salt Lake Sector V (East Kolkata Wetlands), Kolkata 700091, West Bengal
variants.why: Durga Puja brings Bengal together. This Puja uses that moment to honour farmers and show a better way to farm.
variants.next: Take part, or tell us you are interested. Nothing here takes money.
variants.title: You are invited to Durga Puja 2026.
variants.lede: Come with your family and friends to a Durga Puja that celebrates farming. Jointly organised by KarmYog for the 21st Century and Bharatiya Krishak Samaj. Entry is free.

variants.label: H2: living heritage
variants.what: A seasonal presence beside Bengal’s public Puja, not a claim to own it.
variants.when: Durga Puja 2026. Civic dates only, pending Panjika.
variants.where: Munshir Bheri Management / Fishermen's Committee, Near Sukantanagar / Salt Lake Sector V, (East Kolkata Wetlands), Kolkata, 700091, West Bengal
variants.why: UNESCO inscribed Durga Puja in Kolkata in 2021. That inscription is Kolkata’s, not this page.
variants.next: Read what is verified about the Puja.
variants.title: Clay, dhak, and a neighbourhood: BKS is a guest, not a second festival.
variants.lede: The image is clay from the river and returns to water. People walk. Kitchens open. Bharatiya Krishak Samaj does not own that heritage. This site only says where the Samaj might sit beside it in 2026, with the farmer in view.

variants.label: H3: mobilisation
variants.what: A gathering with paths for farmers, supporters, volunteers and partners, none of them a live payment.
variants.when: Durga Puja 2026. Civic dates only, pending Panjika.
variants.where: Munshir Bheri Management / Fishermen's Committee, Near Sukantanagar / Salt Lake Sector V, (East Kolkata Wetlands), Kolkata, 700091, West Bengal
variants.why: Participation is neighbourhood work, not enrolment, and not a donation counter.
variants.next: Express interest. Support does not collect money on this site.
variants.title: Come for the Puja. Stay for the farmers we want to support.
variants.lede: You can read the Puja, understand Integrated Farming as a connected livelihood, and see a mobilisation goal of about 5,000 farmers. None of that is money collected, a farmer enrolled, or a venue invented.
